preconditions.description: The sizes of the given permutations are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n for ai in permutation_a)
preconditions.description: Permutation a contains distinct integers from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= bi <= m for bi in permutation_b)
preconditions.description: Permutation b contains distinct integers from 1 to m.
Permutation a has exactly n elements.
Permutation b has exactly m elements.

postconditions.description: The number of distinct integers d is within the bounds of the size of permutation b.

postconditions.expression: all(ci in permutation_b for ci in sequence_c)
postconditions.description: Each element of sequence c is an element of permutation b.

postconditions.expression: all(ci == ai + d for ci, ai in zip(sequence_c, permutation_a))
postconditions.description: Each element of sequence c is a shifted version of the corresponding element in permutation a by the same integer d.

postconditions.expression: all(ci in permutation_b for ci in sequence_c)
postconditions.description: Sequence c is a subsequence of permutation b.
